description: A deliberate plank variation driving knees forward with strict core control and hip flexor engagement.
setup: Assume a tall push-up plank position with hands under shoulders, feet hip-width apart, and core braced.
steps: Slowly drive one knee forward toward your chest without letting hips pike or drop.
Pause with knee tucked tightly for one full second.
Slowly return the foot back to the starting plank position.
Repeat the controlled movement with the opposite leg.
cues: Move at a slow deliberate pace instead of sprinting
Keep hips level and steady as if balancing a glass of water on your lower back

mistakes.mistake: Bouncing hips up and down rapidly
mistakes.fix: Lock core in place so only the leg moves while hips remain frozen
Lift foot cleanly off the floor throughout the entire tuck

rep_standard: Begins in straight push-up plank, brings knee close to chest with a one-second pause, and returns foot cleanly to start.
